caption:
The tech world loves launching shiny new AI tools, but reality catches up fast. Turns out, 42 percent of corporate AI projects get quietly dumped into the digital graveyard. Are we building actual solutions, or just expensive toys? Let's talk in the comments. 🤖📉

Source: TechCrunch

#TechNews #AIFails #CreatorEconomy #StartupLife #MarketingStrategy

post.news: TechCrunch reported that about 42 percent of corporate AI initiatives are abandoned, alongside a growing graveyard of failed tools and gadgets.
post.take: We spent billions building robots that can write poetry just to watch them join the startup graveyard six months later.
post.insight: Building tech just because it has the word AI attached to it is a fast track to becoming a case study.
